pieces.text: The underlined text tells you that ammonia forms when nitrogen combines with hydrogen.
Because ammonia is produced by this chemical reaction, ammonia is a product.

are always the same, even if the amount of the substance changes. This is because characteristic properties depend only on the substance's chemical structure.
One characteristic property of a substance is its melting point.

(GWIGH-uh-kol), which has a smoky flavor. Guaiacol can be added to food to make it smell and taste smoky. You may have encountered guaiacol naturally if you have smelled wood burning or tasted food cooked over a campfire.
